item.title: 10 Best Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Replacements
item.description: It's been several weeks now since Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave was released for Nintendo Switch 2 , and fans around the world are still exploring this massive game. While you could easily sink hundreds of hours into playing through every Flame Lord's story, you may be wondering what to play after your adventures in Dagda are through. Worry not: we've compiled a list of games like Fortune's Weave to keep your strategic skills sharp while you wait for the story expansion DLC that's slated to be released sometime in 2027. While many of the games on this list are strategy RPGs, some incorporate other standout elements of Fortune's Weave , like its tournament-focused story or the opportunity to recruit dozens of allies.

item.title: PlayStation Officially Cancels Live-service Shooter Fairgames
item.description: Sony has canceled Fairgames (aka Fairgame$ ) three years after the live-service shooter was announced, Bloomberg reported on Tuesday. No one at its developer, Haven Studios, is getting laid off, and instead Haven will support other Sony Interactive Entertainment-owned studios, according to that report.

item.title: 4 Upcoming Fantasy RPGs Better Than Waiting for a New Dragon Age
item.description: The fire’s burning low. The road ahead looks grim. The companion who has spent half your journey needling you clearly has something on their mind, and you’re one or two correct dialogue choices away from getting them to spill. You pick a reply. You feel it land. Then somebody makes a joke about cheese, and the tension breaks.

item.title: How to get the Sinking Lure in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: The Sinking Lure is an optional item you can find in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, but the conditions for finding it are a little confusing. The lure itself isn't necessary for beating the game, and you can't even leave the fishing pond with it, so don't fret if this is something you're stuck on.

item.title: Nobody Said The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Was This Funny
item.description: Though I’ve never played The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time until now, I’ve heard people sing its praises for years. Mostly, this revolved around its impossibly high score of 99 on Metacritic, its influential open world and combat design, and its memorable dungeons. But none of those ardent fans bothered to tell me that this classic game has some genuinely hilarious moments. Because the game was originally released 28 years ago, a spoiler-free experience is pretty much off the table for me. But the goofs and gags? Those are all 100% fresh.

item.title: 2027's Most Stylish Action Game Looks Spectacular in First Official Gameplay
item.description: Tsarevna was announced last year , and immediately grabbed our attention. Billed as the "world's first ballet-inspired" action game on its Steam page , it features motion capture from real-life ballerina Alyona Kovalyova for its hack-and-slash gameplay. In a new gameplay trailer released Tuesday, that ballet action is on full display, making Tsarevna shoot up my list of most anticipated 2027 games.

item.title: Batman Just Officially Saved DC Comics From a Terrible Fate
item.description: Business mergers always come with shake-ups, and Skydance's recent acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery was inevitably going to be messy in some way. What was unexpected, however, was this week's announcement that James Gunn and Peter Safran would be stepping down as co-heads of DC Studios . At the same time, Skydance has initiated layoffs in other divisions such as Skydance Games . One area that seems to have escaped the chopping block for now, though, is DC Comics.
